City of Columbus SNAP Support
item.description:
Immediate Need of Donations

The City of Columbus (CoC) is kindly asking employees to drop off donations of Shelf Stable Food and Goods (see list of items above) to one of the four employee specific drop off sites listed below. Click here to learn more about the City's SNAP Response Plan.

CoC Internal Volunteer Opportunities 

  • PODs Sign Up Genius Volunteer Form (click here): This sign-up genius is for general POD volunteer roles (i.e., Registration, Line Control, Runners, Traffic, etc) for City employees. Sign up for 11/06 and 11/07 volunteer slots are closed. Volunteer slots for 11/10 and 11/12 will open in the near future
  • Parks and Recreation Mobile Produce Markets: Join Parks and Recreation as a Produce Market Volunteer! Their Produce Markets are a great way to interact and support the community as they distribute fresh produce to our neighbors. Come help prep and pack produce in reusable grocery bags for community members.Click here to sign up to volunteer. 

External Volunteer Opportunities 

Interested in further serving the Columbus community? Explore the many external volunteer opportunities linked below! 

  • Local Food Pantry
  • Mid-Ohio Food Collective
  • United Way
  • Hunger Alliance
  • Local Matters
  • Gladden House
  • Besa

item.title: ERG t-shirts are now available!
item.description:
Hello ERG Members,

We are excited to share that ERG t-shirts are now available!

These shirts are more than just apparel — they represent community, belonging, and the collective impact of our ERGs across the City. Wearing your ERG t-shirt is a great way to show pride in your group’s mission, promote awareness of our shared efforts, and strengthen visibility across departments and events. T-shirts are available to current ERG members only, and sizes will be distributed on a first-come, first-served basis as quantities are limited.

Please complete the request form below to provide your preferred size and contact information. You will be able to select one of two available pick-up days. If your schedule does not align with the offered pick-up windows, please email ERG@columbus.gov

to make alternate arrangements.

👉ERG T-Shirt Request Form

 

 

Thank you for your continued engagement and for representing your ERG with pride!

 

Kennedy Billups

Engagement & Impact Specialist

Office of Diversity and Inclusion
